note: This branch is the free edition: all nine skills, frozen at the pre-2.0.0 line. The maintained edition is tracked on the official-agensi branch and ships through Agensi.

features.name: English edition
features.description: Translate all nine skills, the pitfalls catalog, and the README from Spanish to English while preserving commands, paths, and frontmatter.
features.evidence: All skills pass the English-only check in harness/scripts/validate-pack.mjs.

features.name: Branch separation
features.description: Split the project into github-free (the free edition) and official-agensi (the maintained, paid edition).
features.evidence: github-free is the only branch on GitHub; official-agensi is local only.

features.name: Security hardening
features.description: Remove weak root passwords, comment out the default [aur] repo, and guard destructive cleanup commands.

features.name: Pitfalls catalog
features.description: Maintain arch-archlinux-pitfalls as a living, dated catalog of real Arch/archiso failures.

features.name: Repository harness
features.description: Add AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, session-handoff.md, init.sh, and a structural validator so coding agents can work on this repo reliably.
features.evidence: Harness audit scores 100/100 with --target harness; ./harness/init.sh passes 212 assertions.

features.name: Skill harness contract
features.description: Apply the five-subsystem harness contract to all nine skills: Startup Workflow, Scope, Verification, Definition of Done, State & Evidence and Handoff, in a fixed order, enforced by the validator.
features.evidence: All nine skills carry the six contract sections in order; the validator enforces presence, order and the fail-fast Verification block.

features.name: Harness folder
features.description: Move the repository harness out of the repository root into harness/ so the root is a clean product surface, and propagate every path reference.
features.evidence: AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, session-handoff.md, init.sh and scripts/ now live in harness/; the root holds only product files.

features.name: Stale reference cleanup
features.description: Remove references to files that do not exist in the pack (docs/09, docs/04, docs/08-LECCIONES-APRENDIDAS.md), replace the Agensi listing placeholders with the real URL, and gitignore the release zip.
features.evidence: No references to docs/09, docs/04 or docs/08 remain; canonical state files are brief.md and artifact-contract.md; *.zip is gitignored.
